### Run Operations
#### Python
_No operation description provided._
```python
import json, os
from lib.embeddings.sweep import file_hash
digest = file_hash("{{ path }}")
with open(os.environ["STATE_FILE"], "w") as f:
    json.dump({"hash": digest, "path": "{{ path }}"}, f)
```
